From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@fintechco.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming auditor window — portal access and evidence bundle

Hi Sofia,

Quick one — our external auditor (AuditFirm) is scheduled to review Redwood controls next week but I noticed the trust portal guest link we were given earlier shows an expiry on 2028-04-05. Can you confirm whether there is a longer download window for the SOC 2 bundle or if you can provide a consolidated evidence package (zip) for us?

Also, can you confirm the audit period covered by the attached report? The auditor flagged a potential gap between the report end and our review start and wants a short bridge letter if needed.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Amanda
Amanda Li
Senior Compliance Manager, FinTechCo
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming auditor window — portal access and evidence bundle

Amanda —

Thanks for flagging this. Short answers up front:
- We can produce a single evidence zip (MD5 manifest included) that contains the artifacts auditors typically request.
- The trust portal guest link you currently have will expire at 2028-04-05 23:59 PT — we can extend a temporary one-time link or provide an S3-hosted bundle with a 14-day window.
- The SOC 2 Type II report in our portal covers the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31. If your review window starts in early April 2028, we can provide a bridge letter confirming there were no material control changes between 2028-01-01 and 2028-03-31.

Next steps I'd propose:
1) I will ask Security to assemble the evidence bundle and upload it to a secure share.
2) We can extend the portal link for one more week if you need live access.
3) If the auditor needs a signed bridge letter, we will produce it and share a PDF.

Can you confirm whether the auditor needs live portal access (to download individual files) or if a single password-protected zip is acceptable?

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
